# netskope_platform_oauth2_token (Data Source)

Exchanges OAuth2 client credentials for a bearer access token using the RFC 6749 `client_credentials` grant.

The token is re-fetched on every Terraform plan and apply. The `access_token` is sensitive and stored encrypted in state.

**Note:** OAuth2 clients must be configured in the Netskope tenant UI under
Settings → Security Cloud Platform → OAuth2 Settings before using this data source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client identifier.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret.

### Optional

- `grant_type` (String) OAuth2 grant type. Only `client_credentials` is supported. Defaults to `client_credentials`.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The issued OAuth2 bearer token.
- `expires_in` (Number) Seconds until the token expires.
- `token_type` (String) Token type. Always `Bearer`.
